title: Space Bash — Orbital Breakout
description: A self-contained 2–10 contestant arena brawler on a destructible orbital deck: move, grab and throw crates, kick rivals, jump gaps, and outlast CPU opponents. No external runtime assets or network connection are required.

source.provenance: Imported from the user-supplied space_bash_orbital_breakout_v1.13.1_standalone.html. The build is intentionally self-contained and does not require external scripts, modules, WebGL, CDN assets, or a network connection.
